name: Ovation Hollywood
description: Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland Center) is a premier entertainment and shopping destination in the heart of Hollywood, steps from the Hollywood Walk of Fame and the TCL Chinese Theatre. This open-air lifestyle center combines shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences with iconic Hollywood views, including shops, restaurants, movie theaters, and bowling. Located at one of Los Angeles' most famous intersections, it serves as a gateway to Hollywood's entertainment district and offers visitors an immersive experience in the entertainment capital of the world.
demographics: High tourist traffic in the heart of Hollywood, attracting both local residents and international visitors seeking entertainment, dining, and retail experiences near iconic landmarks.
summary: An iconic open-air entertainment and lifestyle destination in the heart of Hollywood, offering world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment steps from the Walk of Fame.
